info.title: Traigent TVL Reactive Import Route
info.description: Import of a compiled TVL runtime contract; zero-native contracts return a closed ReactiveImportReceipt (TRAIG-101). Portal catalog outside the optimization lint roots; the receipt schema stays closed and content-class checked.

post.summary: Import a compiled TVL runtime contract
post.description: Existing create-only import route (Backend: POST /production-requirements/tvl-import). Contracts with exactly one native monitor return the unchanged legacy requirement view. A zero-native contract creates no production requirement and returns ReactiveImportReceipt: 201 first import, new digest with the same semantics, or policy edit; 200 exact replay; 409 genuine native conflict or environment rebinding. P-human only. Tenant and project come from the authenticated request context only. Dark behind PRODUCTION_REQUIREMENTS_ENABLED: while off the route answers the closed 404 reference_not_found. Every error body is the closed envelope tvl_reactive_common_schema.json#/definitions/Refusal except 429.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: Project id of the portal request; authorized against the authenticated tenant.

200.description: Exact replay of an existing import (receipt.created false) or the unchanged legacy response.

oneOf.description: The unchanged legacy native response: the ProductionRequirement view the Backend returns today, modelled by the Backend. It never carries receipt_kind.

schema.description: oneOf(legacy native requirement view, ReactiveImportReceipt), discriminated by receipt_kind == reactive_import (present only on the receipt).

201.description: New import (receipt.created true) or the unchanged legacy response.

oneOf.description: The unchanged legacy native response: the ProductionRequirement view the Backend returns today, modelled by the Backend. It never carries receipt_kind.

schema.description: oneOf(legacy native requirement view, ReactiveImportReceipt), discriminated by receipt_kind == reactive_import (present only on the receipt).

400.description: invalid_request. Closed envelope; nothing is echoed.

401.description: unauthenticated. Closed envelope; nothing is echoed.

403.description: forbidden, fact_source_not_permitted. Closed envelope; nothing is echoed.

404.description: reference_not_found. Closed envelope; nothing is echoed.

409.description: requirement_exists, import_conflict, environment_rebinding. Closed envelope; nothing is echoed.

429.description: rate_limited. Closed envelope; nothing is echoed.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait; the only rate-limit detail on the wire.

500.description: internal_error. Closed envelope; nothing is echoed.

503.description: service_unavailable. Closed envelope; nothing is echoed.

schema.description: Unchanged legacy import body {agent_id, contract, environment_binding}; modelled by the Backend.
